messages:
Maria: Heads-up — failing rerank integration in sampleapp after the Rust SDK parity patch. Experiencing a vector dim mismatch coming from the batching helper.
Jon: Repro steps? what exactly is different between Rust and Python?
Maria: Repro is small — batching 8 inputs. Python helper pads vectors to model dim 1024, Rust helper currently pads to 1536 (looks like a default rounding path). Server accepts it but the rerank consumer expects 1024 and throws an index error.
Steve: Yikes. Is this causing auth/retries or just shape errors?
Maria: Shape errors primarily, but we also saw duplicated rerank calls when the SDK retried without idempotency key which made debugging harder.
Alice: Also noticed the response field ordering changed in the last API patch — "embedding" now comes before "id" in some responses. Quickmapper in sampleapp maps by position not by id so that broke things.
Maria: Minimal request example:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1",
  "input": ["q1","q2",...],
  "batch_size": 8
}
```
And server response snippet we saw:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.001, ..., /* 1536 floats */], "id": "e-1"}
  ]
}
```
Jon: Can you attach the repro script?
Maria: Inline quick repro:
```bash
# samples/repro_rerank.sh
python samples/repro_rerank.py --model redwood-embed-1 --count 8
# prints vector lengths observed from SDK
```
Sam: Short-term fix: I'll add a normalization step to the devex batching helper that forces vectors to model.dim and emits a warning when it had to trim/pad. Will open a PR.
Jon: We should also add server-side validation to reject embeddings with unexpected dims and return a clear 400 + error code so SDKs don't silently accept. And add a metric for "embedding.dim.mismatch".
Sam: Agreed. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/3124 — adds normalization + debug logs. Planning metric + alert follow-up.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 11:00 UTC :rocket:
Alice: After normalization patch, sampleapp passes locally, but the auth-refresh bug still causes a double-send on token expiry. Need to add idempotency-key to embedding/rerank calls to avoid duplicates.
Maria: Filing follow-up ticket for idempotency + response-field-contract. Tagging @devex for prioritization. :point_up:
devex: Thanks — assigning to Sam and Alice as owners. Marked P1 for next sprint.
Maria: Thanks all — will post canary results. If staging looks good we'll merge and canary to prod. :+1:
